summary: Standing is switched back off, before it ever ran. An independent review found that the stage could hold a conversation's lock indefinitely if the database hung during its post-reply write — on a turn that had already answered successfully.
details: Nothing is lost: no conversation had been folded yet, so there is no accumulated position to discard.
The stage bounded the model call it makes but not the two database calls around it, and the code claimed both were bounded.
limitations: The tier stays off until the bound actually covers the database calls and the worst-case hold is re-argued against the timeout this deployment really uses.
